title: Funerals then and now, Sammy Dutrey and Honore Dutrey
summary: He says funeral jobs have changed, and discusses Eureka musicians Black Happy, Sammy Dutrey and Honore Dutrey's lung trouble.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
